Ahadith On Ilm

Say: Are those who know and those who do not know alike? Only the men of understanding are mindful.
(HOLY QURAN 39:9)

The Holy Prophet Mohammad (s):

  • ILM (Knowledge) is the life of Islam and a support of iman (faith) whosoever picks up a little knowledge (ILM) shall get full reward from Allah. Whosoever acquired knowledge and acted accordingly - to him Allah imparts education - which he does not know.

  • ILM is essential to acquire and compulsory for every muslim.

  • ILM is base of every merit and illiteracy is foundation of each demerit.

  • ILM is like treasure and its keys are questions put up questions so that Allah bestow upon you Rahamat (Merciful Blessings) the learned conservation benefits four types of people:

    • one who asks questions
    • one who answers the questions
    • those who hear
    • their friends and attached persons.

  • ILM is momins friend and reserved seriousness is its vazir (minister) wisdom a guied/patience its armyofficer dependence a father merits brother and his lineage is ADMS/Family line Taqva and the reformation of wealth is from valor.

  • ILM and wealth cover up every defect but poverty exposes each demerit.

  • It is quite undue and invalid to stop people from acquiring the knowledge.

  • ILM is Allah's safe debris on earth of which ulema are guarantee there fore whoever acts upon his knowledge frees himself formthe safe debris and who doesn't practice upon knowledge all his actions shall be written with those who embezzles.

  • ILM is safe with its ahl (Worth) and you are ordered to acquire from them.

  • ILM, which is acted upon, is like such treasure, which is not spent. Its master puts himself into troubles for not having spent but for him no gain at all.

  • ILM is like a hidden lamp.

Imam Ali (a):

  • There are two kinds of ILM. Devine (God Gifted) and acquired. If the man does not possess ability the acquired ilm does not profit at all.

  • ILM during the childhood is similar to the engraved writing on stone slab.

  • It leads towards haq(truth) and illiteracy spoils qayamat as well as akhirat.

  • ILM cannot be surrounded it is therefore better to choose fine ilm.

  • ILM is nearer to heart light to blinds and power to the weak bodies.

  • ILM is guide to wisdom and wisdom is its follower, which is bestowed by Allah upon lucky Persons, and unlucky lot is deprived of.

  • ILM saves form hardships and difficulties and illiteracy is more harmful to the body then indigestion.

  • ILM is the murder of foolishness and illiteracy - but is the reason for the worthiness and greatness. The biggest calamity is illiteracy and foolishness.

  • ILM is biggest and most pretty treasure its weight is light and vain but gain is great. It is a means of respect among people and fellow while in solitary hours.

  • ILM is the key of such a door, which leads to open a thousand doors.

  • ILM stops difficulties and obstacles. Illiteracy and foolishness are the worst enemies.

  • ILM is essence of life and having a healing factor, illiteracy is death for living and is caused for misfortune and cruelty.

  • ILM is decoration and ornament for well to do people but is dependence source for the people deprived of.

  • There are three kinds of ilm Knowledge of religion, Medical science (Tibb) and literature.

  • ILM gives encouragement to cross over siraat (Pul-e-Sirat) while wealth and money are hindrance.

  • ILM is the noblest guidance and illiteracy for virtue is worst and also means decline and misguidence.

  • ILM is of course better then wealth. The wealth is spent and results in decreasing but ilm increases if as much as spent.

  • ILM is such a kingdom and authority (Power) who ever gives it for having assaulted with ilm and those who do not have ILM are attacked upon.

  • ILM is wisdom's fruit and reformation like branches illiteracy and foolishness is the root of all evils.

  • ILM guides you in the direction which is ordered for piousness makes the way easy going.

  • ILM is the lost capital of momin.

  • ILM is better then every father and brings together all his worthy fellows.

  • ILM is fruit flourishing for knowing oneself. No other evil than illiteracy and foolishness.

  • ILM lifts trodden people and glorifies with personality and its giving up makes respectful most disrespectful.

  • ILM increases wisdom in wise men.

  • ILM and `Amal (ACTS) are linked together who ever is aalim (Learned) acts upon his ilm and ilm sounds for action that is to say of.

  • ILM is heavenly fruit it is a companion in fear journey and solitude.

  • ILM goes up and up moment after moments and day by day.
